summary: The isolated review approved commit 907c391, but live browser validation exposed a routine /tmp permission case that produced unnecessary inline noise. A post-review fix now accepts usable bounded du output from non-zero exits, so the exact reviewed commit is no longer current and must be re-verified and re-reviewed.
